events.title: The Snared Stag
events.text: A silver stag thrashes in a poacher's snare, one leg bleeding.

success.text: It bounds away. The party feels lighter for it.

failure.text: A hoof catches someone square in the ribs.

success.text: Fresh venison for the road.

failure.text: It tears free and the chase costs you.

success.text: You walk on. The cries follow you for a while.

events.title: Fork in the Fog
events.text: The trail splits and both ways vanish into white.

success.text: Your scout comes back with a sketch of what lies beyond.

partial.text: A glimpse before the fog closes.

failure.text: Your scout gets lost and the party waits, eating into supplies.

success.text: The left path holds. Nothing gained, nothing lost.

events.title: The Lantern-Lit Stranger
events.text: A hooded figure with a green lantern offers trade under the trees.

success.text: A stoppered vial, still warm.
A pouch of glittering essence. No strings, it seems.

failure.text: The gift whispers. Something in the dark now knows your scent.

success.text: The lantern drifts off between the trunks.

events.title: Collapsed Bridge
events.text: A footbridge has given way over a cold, fast stream.

success.text: Soaked but across.

failure.text: The current slams someone into the rocks.

success.text: A sturdy crossing. The forest seems to approve.

failure.text: The planks wash away with your firewood.

success.text: A long walk around. It costs a ration.

events.title: Whispering Moonwell
events.text: A still pool glows faintly. Voices hum beneath the surface.

success.text: Cool light runs through the party's veins.

partial.text: Refreshing, but the humming follows you.

failure.text: The water burns going down.

success.text: The water keeps its glow in the bottle.

failure.text: The glow fades the moment it leaves the pool.

success.text: Some things are best left humming.

events.title: Raider Tracks
events.text: Fresh boot prints and a dropped knife. Raiders passed here within the hour.

success.text: You hit them first and take their purse.

failure.text: They spot your trap and turn on you!

success.text: You give the tracks a wide berth, but you're noticed.

events.title: A Sleepless Night
events.text: Nobody can sleep. Eyes keep drifting to the dark between the trees.

success.text: Laughter around the fire. Everyone wakes rested.

failure.text: The stories turn grim. Still, the warmth helps.

success.text: Your watch spots nothing, and nothing spots you.

failure.text: A long cold night. Everyone is worn.

events.title: Mushroom Ring
events.text: A perfect circle of pale mushrooms. The air inside shimmers.

success.text: You step out with pockets full of something strange and valuable.

failure.text: The ring wakes its guardians!

success.text: The ring blackens and the shimmer dies.
You give it a wide berth.

events.title: Abandoned Wagon
events.text: A tipped wagon, its oxen long gone. The cargo is still under the canvas.

success.text: Coins and a crate of ore.

failure.text: A viper was nesting in the crates.

success.text: Good dry wood.

failure.text: Rotten through. Barely worth it.

success.text: Not worth the risk.

events.title: The Howling Pack
events.text: Howls on three sides, getting closer.

success.text: The pack circles and loses interest.
A roar sends them scattering.

failure.text: They rush you!

success.text: You outpace them.

failure.text: You scatter. Supplies are lost and legs are bitten.

events.title: The Hermit Herbalist
events.text: An old woman tends a herb patch in a sunny clearing.

success.text: She thanks you with a fresh tonic.

failure.text: Hours of picking, and your own food gets eaten.

success.text: She trades a tonic for coin.
She waves back.

events.title: Wall of Brambles
events.text: Thorns as thick as wrists block the trail.

success.text: A clean path, and a view of what lies beyond.

failure.text: The thorns fight back.

success.text: Scratched but through.

failure.text: Snagged and bleeding, and a ration spills.

success.text: It costs a ration of time.

events.title: Crystal Echo
events.text: Crystals ring softly, repeating whispers from somewhere far off.

success.text: The echoes describe paths ahead, and a shard drops free.

failure.text: The ringing gets into your heads and carries far.

success.text: Good ore.

failure.text: It shatters into shards.

success.text: The whispers fade behind you.

events.title: Sunken Cache
events.text: A strongbox sits under a foot of murky water.

success.text: Heavy with coin!

partial.text: You grab a handful before the cold drives you out.

failure.text: The mud nearly swallows a diver.

success.text: Slow, but it comes up.

failure.text: The rope snaps. It's gone.

success.text: The water keeps its secrets.

events.title: Roadside Shrine
events.text: A moss-covered shrine to the forest's old spirits.

success.text: The air softens. The forest seems calmer.
A warmth settles on the party.

failure.text: Silence. Nothing answers.

success.text: Old coins, quickly pocketed.

failure.text: The forest notices.

events.title: The Lost Spirit
events.text: A small glowing figure sits crying in the roots, unable to find its way home.

success.text: It smiles and fades into the bark. You've made a friend.

failure.text: It panics and lashes out before vanishing.

success.text: Its sobbing follows you down the trail.

events.title: A Grateful Spirit
events.text: The little spirit you helped peeks out of a hollow and beckons.

success.text: It shows you hidden paths and leaves a gift.
It chirps happily and the forest seems to ease around you.

events.title: Smugglers' Toll
events.text: Armed smugglers block the trail. "Pay the toll or turn back."

success.text: They step aside, grinning.
A good story and some flattery. They let you pass.

failure.text: They don't like your story. Weapons out!

success.text: Steel it is.

events.title: A Cold Draft
events.text: Air flows out of a crack in the rock, smelling of open sky.

success.text: It leads to a lookout over the trails ahead.

failure.text: A dead end, and a long climb back.

success.text: A warm, sheltered rest.

events.title: Sudden Downpour
events.text: The sky opens. Rain hammers through the canopy.

success.text: You keep your supplies dry.

failure.text: Water gets into the packs and a ration spoils.

success.text: The rain covers your tracks.

failure.text: Chilled to the bone and slipping in the mud.

events.title: The Quiet Glade
events.text: The birds fall silent. The lair is close, but here, for a moment, the forest holds its breath.

success.text: A short, deep rest before what comes next.
No time to waste.

events.title: The Forest Closes In
events.text: Branches creak and shapes move between the trunks. Something has followed you.

success.text: Weapons up!
You slip away, leaving a ration behind.

failure.text: Cornered while running!
